name: TOMATIN - THE SPIRITS EMBASSY 2009
tasting_notes:
Nose: Initially muted, featuring dense toffee, Cadbury’s Eclairs, highlighter pen, and a hint of seaweed. When diluted to 50% ABV, aromas of coffee, charred oak, seared plum, light Soreen loaf, nutmeg, and faintly astringent coriander emerge.
Palate: Complex and concentrated with molasses, dark coffee liqueur, a balance of dry and sweet notes, charred damson, buttery fig biscuit, and slight saltiness. The flavor is intense and layered, though the whisky is not overly hot despite high ABV.
Finish: Relatively short, highlighting the tighter, “closed-up” nature of the whisky early on, but opens subtly with water addition.
comment: Rich prose; dark sweet/sherry-ish core with charred oak edge and small coastal hint. Coffee/molasses tagged under dried-fruit family as the closest fit.
